basic_info.description: Come home to the sounds of the ocean at this gorgeous, 4bd/4ba Outer Parkside gem! Full of natural light and with stunning ocean views and spectacular sunsets, this beautifully maintained home was extensively remodeled in 2016, with Tesla Powerwalls installed in 2017. The main level features a bright and inviting, open concept kitchen, dining area and living room, which lead directly to an impressive, oversized deck, perfect for entertaining or relaxing. Two bedrooms and two full, modern bathrooms complete this floor. The lower level features a large and comfortable family room / flex space, two additional bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including a spacious primary suite. One car garage and laundry closet. A deep lot provides for a beautiful, expansive backyard with endless possibilities. Ideal Outer Parkside location, with both the great outdoors and city amenities at your fingertips. Walk to Ocean Beach, as well as Taraval and Noriega shops, eateries and groceries, including Andytown Coffee Roasters, Galinette, Underdogs Too, White Cap and Gus's. Conveniently located just 1 block from the L-Taraval, minutes to Sunset Blvd or 19th Ave for a quick commute and close to many top rated schools. Incredibly special home, a beach lover's dream, full of every modern amenity.
